• “sleek” (adjective)
• “quickly” (adverb)
• “bounded” (past‑tense verb) | ### Result ``` Original : The feline [hopped] onto the [table]. Enhanced : The sleek feline quickly bounded onto the table. ``` Feel free to tweak the adjectives, adverbs, or verb choice to suit your style.
